name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: We should assign one owner per repository to audit and expand its link coverage, as this approach allows for focused attention and clear accountability. By doing so, we accept the trade-off of potentially slower overall progress, since each owner will need to familiarize themselves with their assigned repository. This trade-off is worthwhile because it enables in-depth audits and targeted expansion, increasing the likelihood of achieving high-quality link coverage. Assigning owners also sets a clear decision-making path, as each owner can make informed choices about their repository's link coverage, which will help us reach our daily 5% increase goal.

name: Scriv
text: Assigning one owner per repo creates a single point of failure—if that person leaves or gets blocked, coverage stalls. Instead, rotate ownership weekly so knowledge spreads and bottlenecks don’t form. Settle it by tracking coverage velocity per repo for two weeks; if rotation slows progress, revert to stable owners.
